title: Luis Fernando Bustos Márquez
text:
Power Systems • Data Center Energy • Microgrids • Photovoltaics
I am a Ph.D. Candidate in Electrical and Computer Engineering at the University of Delaware, with research and industry experience spanning power systems, renewable energy, data-center energy systems, load forecasting, photovoltaics, microgrids, and data analytics.
My work focuses on understanding and designing energy systems that integrate emerging electric loads, distributed energy resources, renewable generation, energy storage, and data-driven methods.




Load forecasting, emerging load behavior, grid impacts, and energy infrastructure for large computing facilities.



Techno-economic analysis, resilience, PV+BESS systems, and grid-connected and islanded microgrids.



Bifacial PV, performance modeling, irradiance analysis, and data-driven power prediction.



Power-system analysis, renewable integration, load modeling, and modern grid challenges.
